skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts and terminology related to Central Banks.
Analyze the functions and operations of Central Banks.
Understand the implementation of monetary policy by Central Banks.
Analyze foreign exchange management activities conducted by Central Banks.
Understand on-site inspection techniques used by Central Banks.
Analyze open market operations conducted by Central Banks.
Understand credit activities managed by Central Banks.
Analyze payment systems operated by Central Banks.
Analyze supervision and regulation activities conducted by Central Banks.
Develop critical thinking skills in analyzing Central Bank operations.
Demonstrate teamwork skills in group assignments.
Develop presentation skills for presenting research findings.
Develop self-learning skills to continuously update knowledge.
Understand legal compliance requirements for Central Bank operations.
